inputs: Public maker/model names and synthetic negative controls; no owner router information used

findings.name: D-Link DIR-859 Router Path Traversal Vulnerability
findings.required_action: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
findings.advice: Listed in CISA KEV by maker and product name only; check the maker's advisory to see whether your firmware version is affected
